title: Thanksgiving and Prayer, The Preeminence of Christ

questions.question: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and ____ our brother, To the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae.
questions.explanation: Colossians 1:1-2 (ESV): "Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, To the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae:"

questions.question: Paul thanks God for them, since he heard of their faith in Christ Jesus and of the ____ that they have for all the saints.
questions.explanation: Colossians 1:4 (ESV): "since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love that you have for all the saints,"

questions.question: Their faith and love are because of the ____ laid up for them in heaven.
questions.explanation: Colossians 1:5 (ESV): "because of the hope laid up for you in heaven. Of this you have heard before in the word of the truth, the gospel,"

questions.question: From whom did the Colossians learn the grace of God in truth, who is a faithful minister of Christ on their behalf?
questions.explanation: Colossians 1:7 (ESV): "just as you learned it from Epaphras our beloved fellow servant. He is a faithful minister of Christ on your behalf"

questions.question: Paul prays that they may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and ____.
questions.explanation: Colossians 1:9 (ESV): "And so, from the day we heard, we have not ceased to pray for you, asking that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,"

questions.question: So as to walk in a manner ____ of the Lord, fully pleasing to him.
questions.explanation: Colossians 1:10 (ESV): "so as to walk in a manner worthy of the Lord, fully pleasing to him: bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God;"

questions.question: He has delivered us from the domain of ____ and transferred us to the kingdom of his beloved Son.
questions.explanation: Colossians 1:13 (ESV): "He has delivered us from the domain of darkness and transferred us to the kingdom of his beloved Son,"

questions.question: In whom (the Son) we have ____, the forgiveness of sins.
questions.explanation: Colossians 1:14 (ESV): "in whom we have redemption, the forgiveness of sins."

questions.question: He is the image of the ____ God, the firstborn of all creation.
questions.explanation: Colossians 1:15 (ESV): "He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation."

questions.question: For by him all things were created, in heaven and on earth... all things were created through him and ____ him.
questions.explanation: Colossians 1:16 (ESV): "For by him all things were created, in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones or dominions or rulers or authorities—all things were created through him and for him."

questions.question: And he is before all things, and in him all things ____.
questions.explanation: Colossians 1:17 (ESV): "And he is before all things, and in him all things hold together."

questions.question: He is the head of the body, the church. He is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in everything he might be ____.
questions.explanation: Colossians 1:18 (ESV): "And he is the head of the body, the church. He is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in everything he might be preeminent."

questions.question: And through him to reconcile to himself all things, whether on earth or in heaven, making ____ by the blood of his cross.
questions.explanation: Colossians 1:20 (ESV): "and through him to reconcile to himself all things, whether on earth or in heaven, making peace by the blood of his cross."

questions.question: Paul says, "Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and in my flesh I am filling up what is lacking in Christ's ____ for the sake of his body, that is, the church,"
questions.explanation: Colossians 1:24 (ESV): "Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and in my flesh I am filling up what is lacking in Christ's afflictions for the sake of his body, that is, the church,"

questions.question: The mystery hidden for ages and generations but now revealed to his saints is: "Christ in you, the hope of ____."
questions.explanation: Colossians 1:27 (ESV): "To them God chose to make known how great among the Gentiles are the riches of the glory of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory."

key_verse_text: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation. For by him all things were created, in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones or dominions or rulers or authorities—all things were created through him and for him.
